title: The functor axioms imply F is an algebraic space
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: Functor-level twin of the stack proposition: lemma-get-smooth provides smooth charts U_{k,x_0} -> F for each finite type field point; the coproduct U is smooth with set-bounded index (axiom [-1]); surjectivity reduces to affine lfp V via the representability criterion, the smooth image U x_F V -> V is open, and finite type points v_0 are hit by the pair (u_{k,x_0}, v_0) with k = kappa(v_0) and x_0 the pullback of v_0.
